Name: Valley Street - Real World Stock Market
Author: Dreamery
Description:
[center][img width=536]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55395/55395-1794419826-267680272.png[/img][/center]

Your crops made you rich. Now put that gold to work

Valley Street adds a [b]trading computer[/b] to JojaMart that connects to the real stock market. Follow real-world stocks, ETFs, crypto, commodities, indices and currencies with live prices, open their charts, and invest your gold in them. [b]1g = $1[/b]: if Apple goes up 5% in real life, so does your investment.

[line]
[center][img width=388]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55395/55395-1794419202-64659240.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]! [/color]Joja Trading PC[/b]: sold at JojaMart for 5,000g, and at Robin's once JojaMart closes, so Community Center players aren't left out. Place it indoors and interact with it to open the market.[/*]
[*][b][color=#f1c232]! [/color]Real prices[/b]: stocks from exchanges around the world, ETFs, mutual funds, crypto, futures (gold, oil...), indices and exchange rates, all converted to US dollars.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]![/color] Search anything[/b] by name or ticker ("apple", "NVDA", "bitcoin") and add it to your watchlist.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]![/color] Charts[/b] for 1D, 7D, 1M, 6M, 1Y and 5Y, with the change, low and high for the period. Hover over the line to see the price at any point.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]! [/color]Buy and sell with your gold[/b]: choose how much gold to invest and get fractional shares, or sell part or all of what you own. Quick buttons for common amounts. Every trade uses the latest price at the moment you confirm.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]![/color] Portfolio[/b]: what you paid, what it's worth now, your profit on what you still own and your profit from sales.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]![/color] Market hours[/b]: see at a glance which markets are open and when the closed ones last traded.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]![/color] Multiplayer[/b]: each player has their own portfolio, saved with the game.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]! [/color]No freezes[/b]: all downloads happen in the background, so the game never stops to wait for the internet.[/*]
[/list][center][img width=388]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55395/55395-1794419220-792594934.png[/img][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod into your [i]Mods[/i] folder or use the Nexus Mod Manager(Vortex)[/*]
[*]In game, buy the [b]Joja Trading PC[/b] at JojaMart, place it in your house and right-click it (A on a controller).[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]![/color] The market runs on real time, not game time.[/b] Sleeping won't make your stocks move. Stocks only move while their exchange is open (no weekends!), while crypto trades 24/7.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]! [/color]Prices can be delayed[/b] by about 15 minutes, as on most free finance sites.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]![/color][/b] Indices (like the S&P 500) and exchange rates can be followed but not bought. ETFs that track them (like SPY) can.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]![/color][/b] Your portfolio is saved with your game. If you quit without saving, your trades are undone along with your gold.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]! [/color][/b]Your investments can lose value, just like in real life. This is a game: nothing here is financial advice, and no real money is involved.[/*]
[/list][center][img width=385]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55395/55395-1794419321-687191877.png[/img][/center]
Run the game once with the mod to create [i]config.json[/i]:
[list]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]! [/color]ComputerPrice[/b] (default 5000): the price of the computer.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]![/color] Symbols[/b]: your watchlist, in order. It's easier to edit from the game: search for an asset and click "+ Add to my list". It uses the same codes as finance.yahoo.com: AAPL, ^GSPC (indices start with ^), EURUSD=X (currencies end in =X), GC=F (futures end in =F), BTC-USD (crypto), PETR4.SA (other exchanges use a suffix).[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]![/color] RefreshMinutes[/b] (default 5): how often prices are updated while the window is open.[/*]
[/list]The watchlist is shared by all your saves. There's also a [i]stocks[/i] command in the SMAPI console that prints your watchlist prices.

[center][img width=383]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55395/55395-1794419361-133942063.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*][color=#ffd966]! [/color]Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ffd966]![/color] [/b]An internet connection. Without one, the mod still loads, but there are no prices.[/*]
[*][color=#ffd966]! [/color]In multiplayer, every player needs the mod.[/*]
[/list]
Translations are welcome!

Manifest.Name: Valley Street
Manifest.Description: Buy a computer at JojaMart to follow real-world stocks, indices, currencies and crypto (in US dollars), open their charts, and invest your gold in them (1g = $1). This mod connects to the internet: prices are downloaded from Yahoo Finance.
Manifest.Author: Daniel
